instructions.english_purpose: Please confirm or edit the suggested Chinese term for each English glossary entry. The Chinese suggestions are starting points, not approved translations.
english_items: Read the English term, definition or meaning, example, and ‘Why it matters’ note before deciding.
Keep every numeric threshold and distinction exact, including ≤ 2%, ≤ 1%, ≤ 0.1%, the 100+ daily-intercessor goal, and the CPM measures.

Use standard Chinese spelling and script. Keep Doxa.Life and DOXA unchanged. Retain UPG, UUPG, and CPM alongside the Chinese phrase unless you recommend a stable Chinese acronym and explain it in Notes.

For biblical phrases, use the wording of the Bible translation most commonly used by your local church or Assemblies of God/Pentecostal community—not merely your personal preference. Record its exact title, abbreviation, edition, and year below. If local communities commonly use more than one translation, list the primary one first and note the others.
Check that related terms form a coherent family, especially engage / engaged / engagement / unengaged / under-engaged / fruitful engagement.
Choose Approve if the suggested Chinese term is accurate, natural in Chinese evangelical and missional usage, and suitable for both prose and interface labels.
Choose Edit if you prefer another term. Write the complete preferred term in the Final Chinese term field; do not merely describe the change.
instructions.local_purpose: 请确认或修改英语词汇表中每个条目的建议中文术语。这些建议只是起点，并非已批准的译法。
local_items: 决定前，请阅读英语术语、定义或含义、例句以及“为何重要”的说明。
准确保留所有数字门槛和区别，包括 ≤ 2%、≤ 1%、≤ 0.1%、每天 100 多名代祷者的目标及 CPM 指标。
使用规范简体中文。Doxa.Life 和 DOXA 保持不变。UPG、UUPG 和 CPM 应与中文表达并列，除非您建议一个稳定的中文缩写并在备注中说明。
圣经用语应采用您当地教会或本地区神召会/五旬节群体最常使用的圣经译本措辞，而非仅按个人偏好。请记录准确书名、缩写、版本和年份。
检查 engage / engaged / engagement / unengaged / under-engaged / fruitful engagement 这一组相关术语是否一致。
若建议术语准确、符合中文福音派及宣教学惯用法，并适用于正文和界面标签，请选择批准。
若您更倾向其他术语，请选择修改，并在最终中文术语栏填写完整术语。
